description: This Java source file defines the 'DefaultThingCommandAdapterProvider' class, which implements the 'ThingCommandAdapterProvider' interface. It instantiates and provides adapters for handling various Thing commands, responses, messages, events, errors, and subscriptions within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework.

classes.name: DefaultThingCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: A provider class that supplies adapters for processing various Thing commands, responses, messages, events, errors, and subscriptions within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: getErrorResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for handling Thing error responses.

methods.name: getEventAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for Thing events.

methods.name: getSubscriptionEventAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for subscription events related to Thing search subscriptions.

methods.name: getModifyCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for modifying Thing commands.

methods.name: getModifyCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for responses to modify commands.

methods.name: getAdapters
methods.description: Returns a list of all instantiated adapters managed by this provider.

methods.name: getQueryCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for querying Things.

methods.name: getQueryCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for responses to query commands.

methods.name: getMessageCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for message commands.

methods.name: getMessageCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for message command responses.

methods.name: getSearchCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns the adapter for search commands.
